definition.simple: How much money you make or lose when price moves one pip in your favour or against you.
definition.balanced: Pip value = position size in units × pip size. The answer is in the [[quote-currency]]. If your account is in a different currency, convert it at the current rate.

example: 10,000 units of EUR/USD: 10,000 × 0.0001 = 1 USD per pip.
